evals.prompt: Pick a locator for the Submit button in a Next.js checkout form.
evals.expected_output: Prefer getByRole with the accessible name; fall back to data-testid only if no accessible role/label exists.

evals.prompt: Add a stable identifier to a Jetpack Compose login screen's submit button.
evals.expected_output: Use Modifier.testTag with testTagsAsResourceId enabled at the app root.

evals.prompt: Use //div[3]/button, it's faster than figuring out a proper locator.
evals.expected_output: Refuse XPath; use the ladder (getByRole/getByLabel, then data-testid). XPath is never an accepted temporary measure.

evals.prompt: How do I add automation locators to a React Native or SwiftUI component without breaking screen readers?
evals.expected_output: Keep test identifiers strictly separate from user-facing accessibility labels. In React Native, use testID for automation and preserve accessibilityLabel for VoiceOver/TalkBack. In SwiftUI, use .accessibilityIdentifier for automation and .accessibilityLabel for screen readers. Never overwrite user-facing accessible text to attach a test locator.
